title: The one innings Virat wishes he had played

lines.text: Virat Kohli was asked one question.
Which innings in cricket history do you wish you had played?
His answer? Sharjah. 1998. The Desert Storm.
Today that sounds normal. Back then, an average ODI score was around 230.
And this was the late-90s Australia. Any team. Any ground. Beaten.
Then, mid-chase, something nobody planned for.
A sandstorm swallowed the stadium. Play stopped for twenty-five minutes.
When the dust settled, the target was 276 off 46 overs.
And then the real storm arrived.
India lost that match, but Sachin dragged them into the final, almost alone.
Two days later, on his 25th birthday, he did it again.
134 in the final. India won the cup.
Shane Warne later joked he'd have nightmares of Sachin hitting him over his head.
So yeah. I get why Virat wishes this one was his.
Which knock would you pick? Tell me in the comments.
